data.narrative:
Percepto is a Series C-stage autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $128M to date. The comparable universe for this stage consists of six private companies operating in the same sector, including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air. No direct public comparables exist in this nascent category.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable valuation technique given limited peer density at Percepto's stage and valuation tier. This approach applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier—typical for Series C advancement—to the $128M in total capital raised as a proxy baseline. This calculation yields an implied valuation of $218M. Peer-Median analysis is not reliably applicable here; while five same-sector peers exist, none satisfied the narrow filters required (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier) to establish a statistically meaningful subset of three or more comparable transactions.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to a single methodology, supports a valuation range of $185M to $250M, with a median point of $218M. Key uncertainties include the sparse comparable set at this stage in the autonomous systems category, which limits cross-validation of the stage-progression step-up assumption, and the nascent nature of commercialization timelines for most peers in this sector. Any refinement would require additional same-stage or adjacent-stage transaction data or clearer revenue visibility across the peer set.
